Ground to Grit.name: Ground to Grit
Ground to Grit.description: The user slaps a full hand to the floor or the street, and the surface crumbles into loose, shifting grit across a room's width while the patch under their own feet holds. Everyone else on it loses their footing: anyone moving falls, and until the end of their next turn nobody on it can run, charge or dodge. Strain: moderate.
